Executive Summary
Millions of India's blue-collar workers — electricians, plumbers, machine operators, welders, delivery
executives — �nd work through referrals, WhatsApp groups, and luck. They have no resumes, no veri�ed
digital identity, and no platform built for how they actually use technology: voice, mobile, and regional
languages. Employers face the mirror problem: hiring is slow, fragmented, and dominated by unveri�ed
skill claims and no-shows.
ShramSetu (�मसेतु — "bridge of labour") is a full-stack recruitment platform that solves both sides with
one spine: trusted digital identities. Unlike a conventional job portal, ShramSetu is a trust system with a
job board attached.
Five pillars:
�. Voice-First Kaam Pro�le — a worker builds a complete, structured pro�le in under 3 minutes by
speaking in English, Hindi, or Telugu; AI extracts and pre-�lls, the human con�rms.
�. Skill Passport (Two-Sided Trust) — tiered veri�cation (New → ID Veri�ed → Skill Veri�ed → Top
Pro) for workers and employers, with a visible approval mechanism.
�. Explainable SmartMatch — every candidate–job match shows a 0–100 score and its reasoning
("Why 87: 5/6 skills, 4 km, wage aligned").

�. Speed Engine — urgent jobs, an "Available Today" worker toggle, and a Kanban hiring pipeline built
to crush time-to-hire.
�. Kaam Card — a public, WhatsApp-shareable skill card, turning the brief's "WhatsApp groups"
weakness into a distribution channel.
Stack: Next.js + TypeScript + Supabase (Postgres, Auth, RLS, Storage), deployed on Vercel. AI is used
strictly as a product component (speech-to-text, extraction, description generation, OCR pre-check)

8. Algorithm Speci�cations
8.1 Match Score (0–100)
score = 100 × ( 0.35·S + 0.25·D + 0.15·E + 0.15·W + 0.10·T ) + bonus
S skill overlap = |worker_skills ∩ job_skills| / |job_skills|
D distance = 1.0 if ≤ 5km (haversine); linear decay to 0 at
worker's max radius
E experience = 1.0 if exp ≥ required; 0.7 if within 1 yr below; else
0.3
W wage alignment = 1.0 if expected within range; 0.6 if ≤ +10% over; else

0.2
T trust tier = New 0.2 | ID 0.5 | Skill 0.8 | Top Pro 1.0
bonus = +5 max, embedding similarity (COULD)
Explanation strings generated from the largest three contributing components. Explainable > black box
— say this in the video.
8.2 Trust Score & Tiers
trust = 30 (base)
+ 20 (ID verified)
+ 10 × approved skill certificates (cap 30)
+ 5 × completed hires (cap 10)
+ 4 × employer endorsements (cap 12) → max 100
Tiers: 0–39 New | 40–59 ID Verified | 60–84 Skill Verified | 85+ Top Pro
Gaming resistance (docs note): endorsements exist only platform-mediated, post-hire.
8.3 Voice Pro�le Pipeline
Mic → Web Speech API (te-IN/hi-IN/en-IN) → transcript
→ LLM extraction → JSON {trade, years_exp, wage, bio, languages}
→ pre-fill form → USER CONFIRMS/EDITS → save (human-in-the-
loop, always)
Fallback: standard form (voice is enhancement, never a blocker)
